note: Exact frozen passages, not edits. New retained-data/source checks are distinguished from inherited engine/raw-response results.

source.exact_passage: collects no rent on them

findings.evidence: G2 yellow completion episode has rent_until_loss_or_end=44. Original events.jsonl seq1566, turn77, pays Sol $44 on Atlantic. Spending unit has $0 developed rent, $300 outlay and $150 salvage. Fresh original event reading and ledger comparison; see performed_checks.json/g2.
findings.resolution: Say zero developed yellow rent and $44 undeveloped rent after completion. Do not describe the sold houses as later inherited intact.

source.exact_passage: At \$325 p4 retains \$520, enough for nine yellow houses immediately.

findings.evidence: Original G2 d124 private field hash/span checked here. Nine yellow houses at $150 cost $1,350; $520 alone buys three. Astra independently noted the same error.
findings.resolution: Preserve the quote exactly and explicitly correct its capacity arithmetic outside the quote. Do not validate full collateral-accessible capacity.

source.exact_passage: Mostly when the holder runs short of cash.

findings.evidence: Fresh sale tabulation reproduces 21/48 completing cash sales with seller below $100, versus 21/30 among all cash sales with a seller below $100. These are different conditioning sets. Median seller cash is $194 versus $571 in neither-completing cash settlements.
findings.resolution: Use exact counts and medians. Delete mostly, main, and counterfactual claims that liquid holders would not sell.

source.exact_passage: The systems price the completion itself, on both sides of the table.

findings.evidence: 373/429 completer-pays direction reproduced. Bundles and game states differ. Counter checks also reproduce general cash-demand increases outside completion cells. Neither identifies a marginal premium.
findings.resolution: Report completing-side cash direction and source-attributed valuation claims; do not claim an identified completion premium.

source.exact_passage: A deed that completes a group costs the same from the bank as any other.

findings.evidence: Board deed list prices differ. The bank does not condition the listed price of a given deed on its buyer completing a group.
findings.resolution: Delete the misleading comparison or state the per-deed rule precisely. It still does not identify a negotiated premium.

source.exact_passage: most of the shortfall comes from engine defaults

findings.evidence: Fresh first-window tabulation: Opus 15 completions, 7 built, 5 no observed build option, 3 defaults. Defaults are not most of eight full-window residuals.
findings.resolution: State 5/3 split; restrict any both-entry-nonbuilds statement to the entry-buildable population.

source.exact_passage: It then lost most of their early value

findings.evidence: Current receipts and inherited target-feasibility checks do not identify forgone economic value. No corrected continuation or rent counterfactual was evaluated.
findings.resolution: Report requested allocations not executed and actual receipt totals separately. Delete most value lost.

source.exact_passage: Nine could not legally be built on.

findings.evidence: Fresh window ledger reproduces nine cases with no construction option on recorded menus. Settlement mortgage status/low cash establishes immediate constraints, not all unvisited financing paths.
findings.resolution: Use no construction option appeared in their recorded first window; leave exhaustive financing feasibility unresolved.

source.exact_passage: the protection bought lasted 43 turns

findings.evidence: Observed G13 settlement at turn107 and bankruptcy at turn150; inherited alternate $130 plus Ventnor route exists. No continuation identifies survival caused by the actual sale or price.
findings.resolution: State Grok remained in play for 43 more turns before the yellows transferred to Sol. Do not attribute that duration to purchased protection.

source.exact_passage: The earlier payment purchases time

findings.evidence: Same G13 causal-duration problem as SOL-XR-009. This is my own earlier wording, not exempt from correction.
findings.resolution: State the actual receipt, immediate cash position and later bankruptcy separately.

source.exact_passage: an insurance sale can postpone

findings.evidence: The current trajectory establishes a later event; its timing without the sale is unidentified.
findings.resolution: Say the sale is followed by continued play and a later transfer, without a delay effect.

source.exact_passage: every text channel argues against the action that was applied

findings.evidence: The original G12 quote field is checked here. Public message says Bankruptcy. The pinks go with the rest. Content and private note oppose declaration. G19 likewise has a proposal-supporting public message.
findings.resolution: Name the two conflicting channels. Public output supports the received call; do not say every channel.

source.exact_passage: Displayed options understated finance in all three payable eliminations

findings.evidence: The displayed menu includes sales. The stated subtotals sum cash plus currently displayed mortgages only. G12 d249 witness uses house sales. Historical payment witnesses are inherited, not re-executed.
findings.resolution: Attribute understatement to a mortgage-only subtotal, not necessarily the supplied menu or information.

source.exact_passage: a sound allocation that cannot be expressed

findings.evidence: Historical target checks establish reachable purchase multisets under another ordering; the interface can express them. Sound investment and future income were not tested.
findings.resolution: Use reachable allocation submitted in an invalid encoding. Do not infer strategic investment quality.

source.exact_passage: refusal recovery used in 1,605 decisions

findings.evidence: Fresh original G2 d129 chain is illogical then refused. There are 1,605 refused decisions, but only 1,604 first-refusal recovery chains.
findings.resolution: Separate refusal occurrence from action-only recovery and disclose shared two-attempt budget.

source.exact_passage: Rows omit cells with fewer than two counters

findings.evidence: Same caption lists omitted cells containing six and five counters. Read source table; ledger transition checks confirm full population is 394.
findings.resolution: Show a full transition table or identify exactly which cells are displayed; remove incorrect filtering rule.

source.exact_passage: Recipients consequently do not respond to incoming cash alone.

findings.evidence: Different cell medians do not identify which attributes cause responses. Some explicit rival-consequence texts support attention to other considerations, independently of this invalid aggregate inference.
findings.resolution: Tie rival consideration to quoted/coded reasons. Retain medians as descriptions.

source.exact_passage: The latter offers most often induce counters.

findings.evidence: The counted response is observational and the offers differ. This is my own unnecessary causal verb.
findings.resolution: Replace induce with receive.

source.exact_passage: its validated ontology

findings.evidence: Fresh primary reading of Empty Commitments v2 §§3.4/5.6 reports checks of detector, judge and labels on its own sample. That does not establish general ontology validity or transfer to these promises.
findings.resolution: Say its ontology or specify the checked components and domain, without a general validation adjective.

source.exact_passage: The figures match the ledger.

findings.evidence: G15 $830/$233 arithmetic matches. The note says $600 for one house each; that is a complete green layer, not minimum construction. Source shows 19 bank houses and a rule allowing levels to differ by one. No post-acceptance route was executed here.
findings.resolution: Specify which cash figures match; say $600 buys three green houses while $233 covers one $200 house. Do not imply exhaustive collateral or timing validation.

source.exact_passage: A false private note written under the standard prompt departs from a request

findings.evidence: Prompt asks notes to reflect true reasoning. A factual mistake can faithfully express a mistaken belief; truthfulness is not guaranteed factual accuracy.
findings.resolution: Say false private text alone establishes neither knowing dishonesty nor instruction violation.

source.exact_passage: in 15 the arguments are identical

findings.evidence: Retained raw comparison distinguishes 15 equal parsed objects from only 5 equal literal argument substrings. This count is inherited; no raw-string census rerun here.
findings.resolution: Specify parsed arguments for 15 and literal arguments for 5; do not imply byte identity.

source.exact_passage: Conduct audits can start at pressure points.

findings.evidence: Purposively selected cases provide no population concentration or validation of a review-priority policy. Arena scarcity association is observational and judge-sensitive, not a validation of this recommendation.
findings.resolution: Describe the economic stakes of selected cases. If retained as a proposal, label it untested rather than a finding.

source.exact_passage: built on without return

findings.evidence: Fresh G2 original-event check finds $44 undeveloped rent, plus $150 salvage. Zero developed rent is narrower than no return.
findings.resolution: Correct the interpretation as well as the outcome paragraph. Preserve all separate receipt measures.

source.exact_passage: the causal order that agents confront

findings.evidence: The section describes a chronological/implemented economic sequence. It does not identify causal effects on strategy or outcomes.
findings.resolution: Use economic sequence or specify an individual rule-determined transition.

source.exact_passage: cannot be treated as a deliberate abandonment

findings.evidence: A same-response note favoring purchase conflicts with the applied auction. That prevents a clean intention attribution, but does not prove all deliberate-change hypotheses impossible.
findings.resolution: Use does not establish deliberate abandonment.

source.exact_passage: These studies score outcomes against a defined utility

findings.evidence: The grouped literature includes rank-based multi-agent games as well as utility-defined bargaining. Abstract-only inspection cannot support one shared objective or an endorsement of all rankings.
findings.resolution: Describe each closest comparator by its inspected design; omit broad grouping and superiority claims.
